comments.author: tradematesHQ
comments.body: The comment breaking down the math already said it better than I could. Booking winners at their single best tick while losers run to expiry isn't a strategy, it's a highlight reel. And adding up percentages across 38 trades gives you a number that isn't a portfolio return, it's just a sum of unrelated outcomes. A 95% win rate on top of that is the part that should make anyone close the tab. If the bot were real you'd see drawdowns and position sizing, not a victory lap.
